scope: Public COM document_save target binding and post-save path verification

root_cause.old_behavior: document_save read ActiveDocument.FullName in one _run call, validated that path outside the COM STA operation, then called _doc() again in a second _run before Save(). A user/client active-document switch between the two calls could validate document A but save document B while returning A's path.
root_cause.impact: Wrong-document mutation plus allowed-path policy mismatch and false success response.

verification.sibling_audit: 7 passed for document_open, document_save_as and document_export_pdf regression cases

live_autocad_2027_session1.fixture_policy: new disposable document -> SaveAs temp DWG -> document_save -> verify path -> close

verification.linux_ruff_note: The current gateway .deps ruff wrapper had no binary; lint authority for the final candidate was the locked Windows venv. The same two files had passed Linux Ruff before the live-test-only addition.

notes: Bound-document reads use existing bounded COM busy-read helpers.
save_as/open/export_pdf remain unchanged because their side effects already occur in one bound _run operation and focused audit did not reproduce A-02.
